has_js_exception.instructions: Does this page step show a JavaScript exception or uncaught error in console_errors?

criteria.true: A JS exception or uncaught console error is present on this step
criteria.false: No JS exception worth flagging on this step

has_failed_network.instructions: Does this step include a failed network request (4xx/5xx, blocked, or net::ERR) in failed_network?

criteria.true: A failed or blocked network request is present
criteria.false: No failed network request worth flagging

has_blank_or_error_page.instructions: Is the page blank, a generic error page (404/500), or missing expected main content for this URL?

criteria.true: Page is blank, error page, or clearly missing expected content
criteria.false: Page renders expected content for this URL

has_broken_cta.instructions: Is a primary call-to-action broken, disabled without reason, or visibly non-functional (dead button, noop link)?

criteria.true: A primary CTA appears broken or non-functional
criteria.false: No broken primary CTA worth flagging

has_auth_failure.instructions: Does this step show an authentication or authorization failure (login error, session expired, access denied)?

criteria.true: An auth or authorization failure is visible on this step

has_a11y_blocker.instructions: Is there a serious accessibility blocker on this step (missing name on focusable control, keyboard trap, invisible focus target)?

criteria.true: A serious accessibility blocker is present
criteria.false: No serious a11y blocker worth flagging

next_action.instructions: Pick exactly ONE next browser action for the driver to execute on this step. Prefer progressing the navigation goal. Use click:<element_id> only for ids listed in state.clickable_elements. Use type_into when an input should be filled (driver supplies text from state.pending_type_text). Use go_url when navigation should jump to state.pending_url. Use done when this seed URL is sufficiently explored or no productive action remains.

criteria.type_into: Type into the target input field; driver uses state.pending_type_text
criteria.done: Stop on this seed URL — explored or dead end
